## 03. Motion in two and three dimensions
<details>
<summary></summary>
<details>
<summary>Position, velocity, and acceleration vectors</summary>
</details>

<details>
<summary>Projectile motion</summary>

$$
\begin{align}
x(t) &= (v_0 \cos{\alpha_0})t \\
y(t) &= (v_0 \sin{\alpha_0})t - \frac{1}{2}gt^2 \\
v_x(t) &= v_0 \cos{\alpha_0} \\
v_y(t) &= v_0 \sin{\alpha_0} - gt
\end{align}
$$

</details>

<details>
<summary>Uniform and nonuniform circular motion</summary>
$$
\begin{align}
a_{\text{rad}} &= \frac{v^2}{R} \\
a_{\text{tan}} &= \frac{d|\vec{v}|}{dt} \\
\left| \frac{d\vec{v}}{dt} \right| &= \sqrt{ a_{\text{rad}}^2 + a_{\text{tan}}^2 }
\end{align}
$$
</details>

<details>
<summary>Relative velocity</summary>
$$
\begin{align}
\vec{v}_{A/C} &= \vec{v}_{A/B} + \vec{v}_{B/C} \\
\vec{v}_{A/B} &= -\vec{v}_{B/A}
\end{align}
$$
</details>
</details>
